property_summary: For any account and any collectable amount, no external call c makes to msg.sender during Collect may re-enter a state-changing entry point of c and still return successfully; the reference lock guarantees any reentrant Collect call reverts, while the mutant lock (deleting locked_=true) lets a reentrant call succeed once.
change_summary: Delete the locked_ = true statement so the reentrancy lock is never acquired.
